title: Familiar physics persisted in video-model answers after simulated rules changed
summary: On matched questions about altered simulated dynamics, Qwen3.8-27B chose the incorrect Earth-normal answer on 94.76% of text-only trials and 63.69% when given ordered frames. Other model configurations showed different shifts.
organization: Fudan University; The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

source_review.scope: v1 model input conditions, reference definitions and Appendix H Table 8

evidence.tested: The authors varied visual evidence for the same questions. Nonanswers remained in the denominator and answer positions varied.
evidence.unknown: The results come from generated scenes and a prompted answer format.
evidence.ai_role: Video-language models infer altered physical rules from matched text and simulator frames.
